mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.UserMapper.info */ SELECT USER_ID AS userId , EMAIL AS email , PASSWORD AS password , ROLE AS role , NAME AS name , PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber , ADDRESS AS address , DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress , IS_DELETED AS isDeleted , DELETE_DATE AS deleteDate , PROVIDER_TYPE AS providerType , KAKAO_ON AS kakaoOn , EMAIL_ON AS emailOn , INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM USER WHERE 1 = 1 AND EMAIL = #{email} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.insert: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.UserMapper.insert */ INSERT INTO USER ( EMAIL, PASSWORD, ROLE, NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, IS_DELETED, PROVIDER_TYPE, KAKAO_ON, EMAIL_ON, INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{role}, #{name}, #{phoneNumber}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, 'N', #{providerType}, #{kakaoOn}, #{emailOn}, NOW() )
